title: Perfect

Fantastic walking tour! We had a wonderful time exploring the city and discovering its history, culture, and hidden gems. Our guide was absolutely amazing – knowledgeable, friendly, enthusiastic, and engaging. The stories were interesting, and the atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable. A perfect way to discover the city! title: A highly recommended visit in Seville
text: A very nice visit with Fernando, an excellent guide, very professional and passionate about his work. He gave us a lot of interesting information and allowed us to discover the city in a very pleasant way. A totally recommended experience!
author: K9955YPmyriamg

title: Best Tour in Seville
text: An exceptional tour with Fernando! Simply spectacular and speechless. Highly knowledgeable professional historian who communicated exceptionally well and conveyed all the information to us. He is very knowledgeable and friendly and we enjoyed the tour and loved every bit of it. We learnt so much with precise information and we felt transported with his unique style of storytelling with passion and enthusiasm. I would highly recommend anyone to book with Fernando. He communicated with us prior to meeting and made it very easy for us to meet him. Loved all his recommendations. Thank you for part
author: 412salmani

title: An interesting tour providing insight into the city's history
text: Valentin was a great guide. Passionate about his city and its history. We saw lots of impressive buildings finishing in the Place de espagne which is magnificent. Also passed some great tapas spots which we very much enjoyed later.
author: relaxedholidaygoer

title: Sevilla Walking tour
